description: This file contains utility methods for file operations, byte and time string parsing, system property checks, and other general utilities used within the Spark network package. It defines the JavaUtils class with static methods for file handling, string conversions, system info, and more.

classes.name: JavaUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for file operations, string parsing, system info, and other general utilities used within the Spark network package.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Closes a Closeable object, ignoring IOExceptions.

methods.name: deleteQuietly
methods.description: Recursively deletes a file or directory without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: forceDeleteOnExit
methods.description: Registers a file or directory for deletion upon JVM exit.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from source to destination.

methods.name: moveDirectory
methods.description: Moves a directory from source to destination.

methods.name: copyDirectory
methods.description: Copies a directory from source to destination.

methods.name: nonNegativeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash code that is non-negative, consistent with Spark's Utils.nonNegativeHash().

methods.name: stringToBytes
methods.description: Converts a String to a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: bytesToString
methods.description: Converts a ByteBuffer to a String.

methods.name: sizeOf
methods.description: Calculates the size of a file or directory.

methods.name: cleanDirectory
methods.description: Deletes all files and subdirectories within a directory.

methods.name: deleteRecursively
methods.description: Recursively deletes a file or directory, with optional filtering.

methods.name: listPaths
methods.description: Lists all regular file paths within a directory.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists all files within a directory.

methods.name: timeStringAs
methods.description: Parses a time string (e.g., '50s', '100ms') into a long value in specified TimeUnit.

methods.name: timeStringAsMs
methods.description: Parses a time string into milliseconds.

methods.name: timeStringAsSec
methods.description: Parses a time string into seconds.

methods.name: byteStringAs
methods.description: Parses a byte size string (e.g., '50b', '100kb') into a long value in specified ByteUnit.

methods.name: byteStringAsBytes
methods.description: Parses a byte size string into bytes.

methods.name: byteStringAsKb
methods.description: Parses a byte size string into kibibytes.

methods.name: byteStringAsMb
methods.description: Parses a byte size string into mebibytes.

methods.name: byteStringAsGb
methods.description: Parses a byte size string into gibibytes.

methods.name: bufferToArray
methods.description: Converts a ByteBuffer to a byte array, avoiding copying if possible.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new directory inside a specified root with a default or specified prefix.

methods.name: readFully
methods.description: Reads data fully from a ReadableByteChannel into a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: readFully
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from an InputStream.

methods.name: copyURLToFile
methods.description: Copies content from a URL into a specified file.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a list of objects into a string separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: stackTraceToString
methods.description: Converts a Throwable's stack trace to a String.

methods.name: checkedCast
methods.description: Casts a long to int, throwing an exception if out of range.

methods.name: contentEquals
methods.description: Checks if two files have the same content or both don't exist.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an InputStream to a String.

methods.name: isTesting
methods.description: Indicates whether Spark is running unit tests.
